entries.subject: Published TESS phase curves as a map of longitude (Wong et al. 2020; Nielsen et al. 2020)
entries.finding: Read on 2026-10-08. Wong et al. (2020, arXiv:2003.06407) detect the atmospheric term (29.6 +8.3/-9.1 ppm) but no eclipse depth: the transit is grazing. Nielsen et al. (2020, arXiv:2003.05932) fit a 57.5 +/- 4.7 ppm cosine read as reflected light only. Neither prints an eclipse depth or a temperature, and the two amplitudes differ by 2.7 sigma, as Wong et al. state.
entries.revisitWhen: A paper prints an eclipse depth with day-side and night-side brightness temperatures from a sinusoid fit of one band.
